items.source: Similar usage pattern like with the dynamic database selection are possible, for example tying a UserSelectionProvider into Spring Security and use the current user as a user to impersonate.
items.translation: 与动态数据库选择类似的用法模式也是可行的，例如将UserSelectionProvider绑定到 Spring Security，并使用当前用户作为要模拟的用户。

items.source: This is a value object for a Neo4j user, potentially different from the user owning the physical Neo4j connection. To make use of this a minimum version of Neo4j 4.4 and Neo4j-Java-Driver 4.4 is required, otherwise any usage of impersonate(String) together with either the UserSelectionProvider or the ReactiveUserSelectionProvider will lead to runtime errors.
items.translation: 这是一个用于 Neo4j 用户的值对象，该用户可能与拥有物理 Neo4j 连接的用户不同。要使用此功能，需要至少 Neo4j 4.4 版本和 Neo4j-Java-Driver 4.4；否则，任何对impersonate(String)与UserSelectionProvider或ReactiveUserSelectionProvider的联合使用都将导致运行时错误。
